'''Presteen''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Presteen system/Legends|Presteen system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Caltinia system/Legends|Caltinia]] and [[Veron system/Legends|Veron systems]]. Presteen was under the control of the lesser [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] of [[House Araba]], based on the nearby planet of [[Cyimarra]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The part of ''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]'' mentioning Presteen describes the state of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] approximately three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sula (queen)|Sula]] of Presteen traveled to the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a floating [[City/Legends|metropolis]] located in the [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] of the<ref name="Rebellion" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. There the [[Monarchy/Legends|queen]] participated in a high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game against players including Cloud City's [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]; the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Corugg]]; and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Elior]].<ref name="Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
Presteen was introduced in the ''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]'', published in [[2001]] for use with the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Rebellion" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
